## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m pytest -q`) and `ruff check .` is clean.
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a regression test.
- [ ] `docs/design.md` is updated if behaviour, signatures, the command line or a file format changed.
- [ ] App text follows `docs/wording.md`.
- [ ] No passwords, keys, patron data, real site settings or vendor files anywhere in the change.
- [ ] Changes to `recipes/chq-academic/` were made in cHQ FOLIO Exchange Recipe first.
